### User Feedback
The project provides a good and interesting interface at entry. 

There are few issues
* Wikidata lookups are not linked to any library entries
* Library entries can only be generated by power users. We should have a plan for this.
* The Report page when we enable and disable a few time, sometimes shifts to the right.
* On mobile devices, switching between nodes (this is via Tab on PC) is not available. 
* The nodes details panel is not very responsive on mobile devices. and Required a High level IA update


THe project offers solid foundation, but needs to be packaged more as a product..
* Can this be imported as a library in other projects? 
* The deeplink are great addition.
